title: Cache miss-ratio curves (LRU vs W-TinyLFU vs S3-FIFO)
what: At 256 MB, S3-FIFO cuts miss ratio by -7.1 pp vs LRU (18.7% vs 25.8%)

reader_questions.question: How much lower is S3-FIFO's miss ratio than LRU at 256 MB?
How is trace-to-trace spread represented?
reader_questions.expected: Spread (SD/CI/points) across 5 trace replays per cache size.

reader_questions.question: Does S3-FIFO's advantage hold across all sizes or shrink at large caches?
reader_questions.expected: It wins at every size, with the largest gains at small/medium caches (64–512 MB) and narrowing at 4 GB.
